record.category: currency exchange rate API (daily updates on the free plan)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0, no card: 1.5K API requests a month with an API key, rates updated once every 24 hours.
free_tier.notes: The quota is soft-capped at 100 percent, with a little extra room. The Free plan has the standard and pair-conversion endpoints and base currency switching; historical data is for paid accounts only. The Pro plan is USD 10 a month for 30k requests, hourly updates and history from 1990. A separate keyless Open API has its own record (data-apis/exchangerate-api-open).

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 1.5K requests a month bound what a free key can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/YOUR-API-KEY/latest/USD (standard) and a pair-conversion request; JSON
record.chaining: Daily rates for all currencies: one call a day uses about 30 of the 1.5K requests a month. The keyless Open API in data-apis/exchangerate-api-open needs no key at all.

record.category: currency exchange rate API, keyless open access

free_tier.stated: Open access API with no key: GET https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, rates updated once per day, rate limited per IP address.
free_tier.notes: The page names no request count and no per-minute number. Requesting once every 24 hours needs no further reading, and one request an hour per server never meets the limit. A rate limited IP address receives HTTP 429 for 20 minutes.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the per-IP rate limit bounds what a caller can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD returns JSON with all supported currencies against the base
record.chaining: A daily table of all currencies with no sign-up; cache it for 24 hours. Pair this with data-apis/exchangerate-api when a key is acceptable.

limits.value: a rate limit per IP address with no published number; a limited address receives HTTP 429 for 20 minutes

record.limits_note: Update rate: once per day. Bulk path: none; the page asks to cache the daily table.
record.binding_note: The only limit is the per-IP shaping with no published threshold; one request an hour never meets it.
record.reliability_note: A rate limited IP address receives HTTP 429 and is let through again after 20 minutes.
record.confidence_note: Limits and license are quoted from the open access docs page. One keyless GET answered HTTP 200 with a success body; the rate threshold was not measured.
